<!-- What changes for someone using pi-squire, in a sentence or two. -->

- [ ] `pnpm check` passes.
- [ ] A user-visible change has an entry under `## [Unreleased]` in `CHANGELOG.md`.
- [ ] A test changed to match new behaviour is named here and in `CHANGELOG.md`.
- [ ] A change to a hook example in `README.md` is called out as a contract change.
- [ ] A change to launching was tried in Pi, inside tmux, with `pi -e <this checkout>` and a `message:*` provider installed.
